Video Title: 46 City Council al fateha Recitation by Rashad Khalifa
Speaker: City Council Member
Description: A short clip from a Tucson city council meeting at which Dr. Rashad Khalifa, introduced as imam of the Islamic mosque of Tucson, delivers the evening's invocation. After the roll call and the clerk's announcement, he recites Sura 1, Al-Fatehah, in English translation, rendering it as praise to God, Lord of the universe, Master of the Day of Recompense, and a request to be guided in the right path. The recording runs just over a minute and closes with "Amen."
